I've replied to Dana in your DM. Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the seat count at 185. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her that 185 is still the active count today. Amendment No. 3 was signed on 2026-09-22 and raises it to 230 seats, but only from 2027-01-01.

A seat count isn't a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so no approval was needed.
